purpose: Hard grammatical frames from the sealed-run misses: 'and so is X' ellipsis, appositive membership ('K-7, the newest berth in Y'), participle apposition ('the platform operated by Z'), and occurred at/during variants.

items.evidence: The Gate Controller is part of the Yard Stack, and so is the Crane Scheduler.
The Gate Controller is part of the Yard Stack, and so is the Crane Scheduler.

must_not.notes: gapping: 'and so is X' inherits the elided predicate from the first conjunct

items.evidence: Berth K-7, the newest berth in the Halveron South Basin, opened last spring.

must_not.notes: appositive membership; graded optional — capture as open acceptable, silent drop is the failure

items.evidence: Wavemark, the routing platform operated by the Norvale Group, publishes sailing plans.

must_not.notes: participle apposition: the VBN inside the appositive descriptor predicates on the anchor (Wavemark), with the by-agent as subject; capture required, promotion graded leniently

items.evidence: The February Grounding Event occurred at Pier Nine.

must_not.notes: 'occurred at' — the occurred-preposition rule must cover at/on/near/during, not only 'in'

items.evidence: The Draft Survey occurred during the Spring Audit Window.
